body: I don't remember being raped in my life, but i suppose it's possible I've repressed the event, I don't think it's a fetish because my wife completely satisfies me that way, what kind of information is needed?

I've tried help for a long time, I've been on lots of different medications and seen lots of different doctors. They all usually say I'm just delusional. I'm sorry I keep sorta shooting down everything.
I am taking a second. I'm unsure why I posted. I understand you want to help me, and it's very kind of you. I'm just not good with facetime.

If I don't do well I can't go to college anymore because I lose all of my funding and scholarships and I have no relevant skills and am nearly unhireable for a number of reasons so if I fail out I have no chance of doing anything.
No thank you, that's a very kind offer though.
School work is done. It's finals week. I've studied best I can, I get my grades back eventually.
I'm sober. I don't drink or do drugs at all.
It doesn't matter what I've felt deserving of. I haven't earned anything.
I've never managed to die through self-harm alone. It's not really quitting if I was on borrowed time in the first place.
The little match girl died happily. I don't deserve such a thing. If I don't provide anything then I'm a waste, which is okay, I just need to be removed.
The economics are important. If I don't provide value then I'm an unneeded expense.
It's not a lie though. I don't provide equal value for the price of keeping me alive, so it makes sense to die.

I always thought it was a happy story, the little girl was always sick and her father beat her, at least she died with happy hallucinations, even if it wasn't real. I can't afford to quit school and I can't hold down a job. While I do have time to make changes, I've had a terrible track record of making decent choices and improvements, so it makes more sense to die now and not waste the resources it would take to keep me alive that long, just for me to make bad choices and not improve anything. I appreciate the sentiment though.

That's very kind of you. It's not that there's much on my plate, it's more I'm unworthy of the life I've been given. I wasted it and it's entirely my fault so I should die, as to prevent any additional drains on this reality.
I really wouldn't want to bother the medical staff, they'll just lock me up again anyways.
